verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a postmortem workflow: tracking completion with list views, a post-incident flow, and policies (docs-5), plus AI first drafts, inline review suggestions, and section redrafting (docs-6). Its auto-generated, customizable timeline (docs-4) is a plausible drafting source, but the pack never shows drafts are built from it or covers two of the four stages. missing for 10: postmortem templates, explicit timeline-to-draft generation, human review/approval steps, postmortem publication or sharing, independent hands-on corroboration.
